assertions: The documented official GET /api/douyin/v1/video/get_iframe_by_video endpoint returns a known public VideoID without an account, credential or requested permission.
The returned title, width, height and official player URL preserve the exact requested VideoID and match the reviewed public fixture.
The Connector uses one fixed open.douyin.com endpoint, a contactable application User-Agent, no redirect, no retry and a 64 KiB response limit.
The normalized output excludes raw iframe HTML, platform log IDs, author identity, interaction metrics, comments, media URLs, tokens, cookies and raw payloads.
